title: EvoAl memory model: execution finished
description: Written once after the last iteration, when the run is finished (ExecutionRecorder.finishRun). Signals clients that no further iteration files follow.

numberOfIterations.description: Number of iteration files written (iteration-0.json up to iteration-<numberOfIterations - 1>.json).

best.description: Ids of the best individuals of the last iteration (rank 0).

metrics.description: Final values of the execution metrics (scope 'execution'), e.g. limits.
